name: CORIAN passive RF array (CACI)
description: Fixed-site networked passive RF sensor array. TDOA multilateration across nodes geolocates the Group 1-2 sUAS AND its ground operator; positive ID by an unclassified signal library. JCO fixed/semi-fixed interim selection. Range is a planning figure, not a published one.

classifyRangeM.condition: protocol identification range (representative) — Set equal to detect range because protocol/library identification in a passive RF receiver happens at the moment of detection: the signal must be demodulated far enough to match the library entry. No separate classification range is published.
classifyRangeM.source: CACI, Fixed Site C-UAS (CORIAN datasheet F539 02/25)
classifyRangeM.note: Inventory records 5000 m at INFERRED REPRESENTATIVE; the seed leaves the field null

sectorDeg.condition: azimuth coverage — Datasheet: CORIAN 'utilizes a sensor array' and is 'Modular and scalable for geographically compact or wide-area defense'. A distributed multi-node array has no single boresight, so 360 is the honest encoding. Per-node antenna pattern is not published.
sectorDeg.source: CACI, Fixed Site C-UAS (CORIAN datasheet F539 02/25)
